name: Sapieha Palace, Vilnius
scope: The restored palace at L. Sapiegos g. 13, including the main Baroque block, four corner pavilions, park-facing west entrance and curved fronton, north and south arcades, and the later round east addition.

originalReview.notes: The original matches photographer Kontis Šatūnas’s signed author upload bytes. The 2009 view controls surviving wall bays and trim. The later registered reconstruction controls the restored roofs, pavilions and galleries.

review.notes: Started with Qualla media. The selected artist-originated photograph was matched to the original public-domain release. Other photographs, engravings with uncertain provenance, and the 2024 CC-BY-SA images were excluded.
